title: Procurement Executive
summary: A Procurement Executive buys the materials and services a company needs, turning internal requests into purchase orders at the right price, quality and delivery date. They sit in the purchase or procurement team and work with vendors, stores, user departments and accounts.
dailyDuties: Review purchase requisitions from user departments
Send RFQs and compare vendor quotations
Negotiate price, delivery and payment terms with vendors
Raise purchase orders in the ERP and get approvals
Follow up with vendors on pending deliveries
Onboard new vendors and update vendor master data
Coordinate invoice and payment issues with accounts

skills.expectation: Turn purchase requisitions into purchase orders and follow up deliveries
Find and develop new and alternate vendors
Float RFQs and prepare quotation comparisons
Negotiate price, delivery and payment terms with vendors
Onboard vendors and maintain vendor master data
Raise and track purchase documents in an ERP or e-procurement tool
Track open orders and vendor data in spreadsheets
Check GST details on vendor quotes and invoices
Coordinate invoice matching and vendor payments with accounts
Coordinate clearly with vendors and user departments
